rDNA 18s 28S sequences of 12 species of Mealybugs are highly conserved and can be used only for the species-level identification.
18S and/or 28S rDNA are not appropriate for phylogenetic analysis and identification of mealybug species.
18S and28S rDNA are suitable for species-level identification,but not for intraspecific identification of mealybugs.

18S and/or 28S rDNA sequences are suitable for species-level identification of mealybug species,but mtDNA COI is more suitable for species-level and even subspecies-level identification.
the rDNA 18s 28s sequences can be used to distinguish different species of mealybugs at species level, and mtDNA COI is more suitable for species identification and molecular phylogenetic analysis.
